Hi
I'm doing well, thank you. I hope you two are too! Sorry for the slight delay in responding. I was gathering the materials
and links to send you.

Please find enclosed the participant list and scenarios that were used as the basis for the workshop (these documents are
not public information, so please be mindful and not share). In addition to that, you may view the videos from our public
event on our Al Great Debate event page. Bloomberg news wrote an interesting piece upon conclusion of the workshop,
entitled Al Scientists Gather to Plot Doomsday Scenarios (and Solutions). Additional postings about the event include an
Origins blog.post, and ASU News article.

We are in the process of editing the footage from the actual workshop. Once we do, we'll curate it and the materials
shared and discussed, to create an experience for people to explore and learn from via our Origins Education Portal.
Whenever that is completed, we'll be sure to share.

Please let me know if there's anything else you may need and/or if you have any questions.

All the best,
